messages:
carolyn: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need final owners for customer-facing comms and a policy for RCA sharing. Who can own the statuspage blurb and short customer summary?

mike: I can take the summary. Draft suggestion: 
```
At 14:12 UTC we saw elevated errors affecting some hosted inference requests. Traffic was routed to fallback capacity and service recovered by 14:45 UTC. A full incident summary and remediation plan will be posted within 7 days.
```

sudha: That reads well. Please avoid internal jargon; call it "partial degradation" if not everyone lost service. Also mention mitigation (fallback) so customers know we reduced impact.

elaine: Legal note: public posts must not include customer IDs or internal ticket numbers. Policy idea: default internal RCA; publish a sanitized public summary for Level 1 incidents and allow impacted customers to request more detail.

tony: I'll own the statuspage edit and publish within 24h. Mike, drop your draft in #incidents-drafts and I'll push live after review.

mike: Will post draft in ~30m.

carolyn: Action items:
- Statuspage blurb: owner=tony, ETA=24h
- Short customer-facing summary (1-2 paragraphs): owner=mike, ETA=48h
- Full internal RCA: owner=sudha, ETA=7d
- RCA sharing policy decision: owner=elaine, ETA=3d
- Recurring-pattern analysis (3 incidents last 6w): owner=carolyn, ETA=7d

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-312: internal RCA doc created (access restricted).

sudha: Proposed RCA sharing tiers:
- Tier A (>5% customers or paid tiers impacted): publish anonymized public RCA summary + offer tailored addendum to impacted customers.
- Tier B (partial/perf degradation): public short summary, full RCA internal unless requested.
- Tier C (internal only): internal RCA only.

elaine: Tiering OK. Add clause for regulator requests and large enterprise customers; handle case-by-case.

mike: Should support link to a sanitized RCA be attached to support tickets when customers ask, or should we craft a one-off sanitized doc?

carolyn: Prefer creating a sanitized artifact per request. Action: RCA sanitization template. Owner=mike+elaine, ETA=5d. Support will send sanitized doc and escalate to legal/sales if more detail needed.

tony: I'll add a brief FAQ line on the statuspage: "Impacted customers will receive an email with next steps and a short incident summary."

sudha: Noting pattern: two prior incidents showed slow failover when a model shard hit KV cache pressure. I'll include pattern analysis in the 7-day RCA. If confirmed, propose adding recommendations to Redwood Optimize and Dedicated autoscale rules.

carolyn: I'll file a recurring-pattern ticket and link to remediation backlog.

elaine: Timeline confirmation for comms: status update within 24h, targeted customer emails within 48h, sanitized public summary + next steps within 7 days. If legal needs more time, notify stakeholders.

mike: Draft posted in #incidents-drafts: https://slack.redwood/drafts/1763951400. Please review.

tony: Reviewing now. Suggest wording change: don't say "we continue to investigate" unless we mean open investigation; prefer "we identified mitigation and are implementing a long-term fix" only if applicable.

carolyn: Agreed. Use cautious language.

ops-bot: Reminder: action statuspage-edit assigned to tony (due in 86400s).

mike: Updated draft with cautious wording and mitigation mention: "we routed traffic to fallback capacity to reduce impact."

elaine: I'll confirm legal stance on sharing template in 72h.

carolyn: Final recap before close:
- Tony: publish statuspage blurb (24h)
- Mike: customer-facing summary + sanitization template (48h / 5d)
- Sudha: internal RCA + pattern analysis (7d)
- Elaine: legal confirmation on RCA sharing (3d)
- Carolyn: recurring-pattern ticket + remediation link (7d)

If no objections, I'll close. Ping me if you need reassignment. :thumbsup:

mike: all good

tony: posting status update now, will ping when live

ops-bot: Status update posted to status.redwood.ai: "Partial degradation resolved  incident summary forthcoming."

carolyn: Thanks team, closing thread unless blockers appear.
